184: class StreamFilterExtension(Extension):
185:     def filter_stream(self, stream):
186:         for token in stream:
187:             if token.type == "data":
188:                 yield from self.interpolate(token)
189:             else:
190:                 yield token
191: 
192:     def interpolate(self, token):
193:         pos = 0
194:         end = len(token.value)
195:         lineno = token.lineno
196:         while True:
197:             match = _gettext_re.search(token.value, pos)
198:             if match is None:
199:                 break
200:             value = token.value[pos : match.start()]
201:             if value:
202:                 yield Token(lineno, "data", value)
203:             lineno += count_newlines(token.value)
204:             yield Token(lineno, "variable_begin", None)
205:             yield Token(lineno, "name", "gettext")
206:             yield Token(lineno, "lparen", None)
207:             yield Token(lineno, "string", match.group(1))
208:             yield Token(lineno, "rparen", None)
209:             yield Token(lineno, "variable_end", None)
210:             pos = match.end()
211:         if pos < end:
212:             yield Token(lineno, "data", token.value[pos:])
